subject: Forecast reconciliation: coverage shortfall & escalation matrix
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast reconciliation: coverage shortfall & escalation matrix

Team —

Quick summary up front: quota for Q3 = $3,200,000. Current committed value in HubSpot = $2,100,000. Including best-case laterals (O/C), coverage sits at ~1.6x if we count upside; committed-only coverage is 0.66x. We have a coverage shortfall that needs triage and a clear escalation matrix if we can't get to 1.2x committed by lock.

What I need from each of you by EOD (internal only):
- Ben: consolidated list of deals we believe can be moved to commit this week (deal id + ask + blocker).
- Rishi: updated pipeline velocity adjustments and any anticipated churn/downsells we should reduce for the quarter-end number.
- Laura: adjusted forecast that reflects collection timing and finance reserves — surface any revenue recognition risks.

Please use the attached snapshot (Q3_coverage_snapshot.xlsx) — I highlighted the top 12 deals by ARR and flagged confidence levels. If we can't hit committed coverage >= 1.2x by Friday 23rd 11:59 PM PT, we'll need to escalate to Leadership for temporary credits / reprioritization.

I'm scheduling a 30-minute commit review at 16:00 PT today to reconcile final updates (calendar invite to follow). If you cannot make it, send bullet updates in reply and mark owners.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Q3_coverage_snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast reconciliation: coverage shortfall & escalation matrix

Got it — good call. A few quick items:

- I've pulled my book and marked the deals I think can realistically be committed this week (see inline). I'll follow up 1:1 with the AEs owning those to confirm PoC/contract dates.
- Suggested owners: Jasmine owns Peregrine (DG-2391), Sam will push on Helio (DG-2376), Priya on NovaHealth (DG-2389).
- If we still miss the committed coverage by lock, we escalate to Sales Leadership + Finance for a short list of approved mitigations (partial credits, payment deferral, extend close-by grace).

Agenda for the 30-min review (attached):
1) Quick top-12 roll call (5m)
2) Confirm commit moves and blockers (15m)
3) Finance reconciliation & immediate mitigations (8m)
4) Next steps / owners (2m)

Please come with one concrete next step per deal (example: 'send redline to customer by 2pm' or 'contract deliverable due 3pm w/ signer X').

Thanks — I'll add the calendar invite.

Ben Carter
Sales Manager, Enterprise West
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: commit-review-agenda.docx (document)]
